environment.description: Service deployed on AWS EC2 (m5.large) in us-east-1 VPC with IMDSv1 enabled. Pod runs with host networking in EKS cluster. No egress filtering. IAM instance role 'ws-service-role' has s3:*, sts:AssumeRole permissions. Service credentials (config.AuthToken) are loaded from environment variable at startup and remain static for the lifetime of the process (rotated only on deploy, typically weekly).
